# Localisation

## Localisation architecture

::: {.localisation-slide}

![](img/05_localisation/localisation_architecture.svg){.localisation-architecture-diagram}

::: {.localisation-architecture-summary}
::: {.localisation-stages}
1. Drivers and the mobile-base controller publish raw ROS 2 data.
2. Plugins convert each stream into typed Bayesian observations.
3. A configurable Kalman filter fuses them into `nav_msgs/msg/Odometry`.
:::

::: {.localisation-observation-table}

| Proprioceptive observations | Exteroceptive observations |
| --- | --- |
| `twist` | `position` |
| `linear speeds` | `course` |
| `angular speed` | `pose` |
| `attitude` | `range` |

:::
:::

New information sources only require a compatible observation plugin and the
corresponding updater configuration. ROMEA also provides plugins for RTLS
systems and radars, and alternative Kalman filters.

:::

## Localisation plugin profiles

::: {.columns .config-slide}
::: {.column width="58%"}

#### Meta-description launch entries

::: {.config-path}

```text
config/
  wgs84_anchor.yaml
  robot/
    base.yaml
    devices/
      *.gps.yaml
      *.imu.yaml
```

:::

```yaml
# base.yaml
launch:
  - include:
      file: "$(find-pkg-share romea_mobile_base_meta_bringup)/profile/localisation_plugin.launch.py"
      arg:
        - {name: controller_topic, value: odom}

# devices/*.gps.yaml
launch:
  - include:
      file: "$(find-pkg-share romea_gps_meta_bringup)/profile/localisation_plugin.launch.py"
      arg:
        - {name: wgs84_anchor_file_path, value: $(var wgs84_anchor_file_path)}
        - {name: odom_topic, value: /$(var robot_namespace)/base/controller/odom}

# devices/*.imu.yaml
launch:
  - include:
      file: "$(find-pkg-share romea_imu_meta_bringup)/profile/localisation_plugin.launch.py"
      arg:
        - {name: odom_topic, value: /$(var robot_namespace)/base/controller/odom}
```

:::

::: {.column width="42%"}

#### What is launched ? 

::: {.config-table}

| File | Plugin output |
| --- | --- |
| `base.yaml` | odometry observations |
| `*.gps.yaml` | position and course observations |
| `*.imu.yaml` | angular speed and attitude observations |

:::

::: {.config-table}

| Argument | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `controller_topic` | Selects base odometry source |
| `wgs84_anchor_file_path` | Converts GPS to local ENU |
| `odom_topic` | Helps GPS/IMU interpretation |

:::

#### Notes

::: {.compact-notes}

- The filter does not consume raw sensor topics directly.
- Each plugin converts one runtime stream.
- Outputs are typed localisation observations.
- These observations are consumed by the Kalman filter.

:::

:::
:::

## Localisation filter configuration

::: {.columns .config-slide}
::: {.column width="48%"}

#### Configuration file

::: {.config-path}

```text
config/
  wgs84_anchor.yaml
  robot/
    localisation.yaml
```

:::

#### Kalman filter

::: {.scroll-code}

```yaml
filter:
  state_pool_size: 1000
predictor:
  maximal_dead_recknoning_travelled_distance: 2.
  maximal_dead_recknoning_elapsed_time: 10.
angular_speed_updater:
  minimal_rate: 10
twist_updater:
  minimal_rate: 0
linear_speeds_updater:
  minimal_rate: 10
position_updater:
  minimal_rate: 1
  trigger: always
  mahalanobis_distance_rejection_threshold: 10.
course_updater:
  minimal_rate: 1
  trigger: once
  mahalanobis_distance_rejection_threshold: 10.
pose_updater:
  minimal_rate: 0
  trigger: always
  mahalanobis_distance_rejection_threshold: 10.
attitude_updater:
  minimal_rate: 10
publish_rate: 10
debug: true
```

:::

:::

::: {.column width="52%"}

#### Configurable fields

::: {.config-table}

| Section | Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | `state_pool_size` | Buffered filter states |
| `predictor` | dead-reckoning limits | Reset protection |
| `<updater>` | `minimal_rate` | Expected rate; `0` inhibits |
| `<updater>` | `trigger` | `always` or `once` |
| `<updater>` | `mahalanobis...` | Outlier rejection threshold |
| root | `publish_rate` | Output publication rate |
| root | `debug` | Enables debug outputs |

:::

::: {.config-table}

| Updater | Typical producer | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `twist_updater` | odometry plugin | proprioceptive |
| `linear_speeds_updater` | odometry plugin | proprioceptive |
| `position_updater` | GPS plugin | exteroceptive |
| `course_updater` | GPS plugin | exteroceptive |
| `angular_speed_updater` | IMU plugin | proprioceptive |
| `attitude_updater` | IMU plugin | proprioceptive |

:::

#### Notes

::: {.compact-notes}

- The filter works in the local ENU frame defined by `wgs84_anchor.yaml`.
- Each updater consumes one typed observation stream.
- `trigger` applies only to exteroceptive updaters.
- An updater is inhibited when its section is omitted.
- `minimal_rate: 0` also inhibits an updater.

:::

:::
:::

## Localisation launch flow

::: {.localisation-flow-slide}

![](img/05_localisation/localisation_launch_flow.svg){.localisation-launch-flow-diagram}

From the mobile-base and sensor meta-descriptions, TIRREX composes the robot
through `romea_robot_meta_bringup`. The component-specific
`romea_*_meta_bringup` profiles start the odometry, GPS and IMU observation
plugins. In parallel, `robot_localisation.launch.py` starts the Kalman filter
from `localisation.yaml`; both branches meet on typed observations.

:::
